🌟 another | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Mirroring and controlling an Android device from a desktop computer, with advanced features for automation and AI integration.
✨ Key Features: • Real-time screen mirroring (H.264/H.265) • Adaptive video bitrate • Macro recording and management • Wi-Fi mirroring • Device audio forwarding (Android 11+)
📖 Summary: Another is a desktop application that allows users to mirror and control their Android devices on their computer via USB or Wi-Fi. It leverages scrcpy for streaming and input, offering features like screen recording, macro recording, and AI agent integration through an MCP server.
